pairs.registryProposal: machine-owned-regions says the block names when its generator last ran; a timestamp inside a committed block churns a git diff on every scan. Consider allowing the run stamp to live in the artifact the block points at (here context-map.json generated_at) when the block is the pointer form. Also: the fence contract could name the half-fence case (START without END) explicitly as the splice failure that writes outside the fence.
